Kling 4.0 Flash Is Now Fully Available! ⚡

Kling 4.0 Flash is now available to everyone on the Kling AI website and via API.

You can also access it through MCP, CLI, and AI plugins, bringing greater flexibility to your video creation workflows. With Kling plugins for professional creative tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and After Effects, you can integrate video generation directly into your creative process.

Ready to create? You call the shots.
